Both letters open with the paradox that the traffic-fatality rate has improved while the absolute toll remains a serious national problem; identify the established Action Program as effective when fully applied; call for stronger organized public support; and culminate in a request that the addressee lead a renewed conference-based safety effort. C11 and C24 share much of the same traffic-safety and conference machinery, but C20 most closely matches the child's full argumentative and operative sequence.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Despite the fact that the 1955 traffic accident record showed a decline on a vehicle-mile basis, the number of fatalities on our streets and highways continues a major national concern.","parent_excerpt":"While the continuing efforts...have resulted in a reduction in the rate of accidents, the great increase in traffic has caused an increase in the total number of accidents and fatalities","explanation":"Distinctive shared opening logic contrasts improvement in the rate with a persistently serious or increasing absolute fatality toll."},{"child_excerpt":"we must move forward more rapidly in applying the traffic safety measures set forth in the Action Program...Organized public support for these proved techniques","parent_excerpt":"This Conference adopted an Action Program...This Action Program has produced gratifying results wherever it has been applied fully...We should enlist the active support of business and other civic groups as well as public officials.","explanation":"Both treat the Action Program as a proven framework and prescribe broader organized citizen and official support to achieve fuller application."},{"child_excerpt":"will you, therefore, as Chairman of the President's Committee for Traffic Safety, arrange for these conferences as soon as possible","parent_excerpt":"I should like to have you spearhead a renewed highway safety program and serve as General Chairman of the President's Highway Safety Conference.","explanation":"The same sequence culminates in a direct request that a designated chairman organize or lead a renewed, conference-centered traffic-safety campaign."}]}
